description: Send a quote request to Karved with the customer's contact details — works either with a design_id from create_design OR without uploaded artwork yet (pass blank_shape_id or item_description, or supplied_blank: true). Only call it after the customer agreed. Our team replies by email within one business day. Nothing is charged, ordered, or emailed automatically.

artwork_status.description: e.g. "will email logo", "needs design from scratch"

blank_shape_id.description: Cup id from list_cups (when no design_id is supplied)

item_description.description: Item / vessel description when no design_id is supplied (or for supplied blanks)

needed_by.description: The date or event, in the customer's words

supplied_blank.description: True when quoting decoration on customer-supplied blanks (50+ pieces)

name: request_quote
title: Request a quote from our team
